## What is Bioconductor?

[Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.org){target="_blank"} is an open-source,
open-development project that provides thousands of R packages for the
analysis and comprehension of biological data, such as genomics,
transcriptomics, single-cell, proteomics, metabolomics, and microbiome data.
Behind the software is a welcoming, international community of users and
developers who share code, teach courses, and meet at conferences.

[Visit Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.org){.btn .btn-dark .rounded-pill target="_blank"}

::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6}

## The Finnish Bioconductor community

The Finnish Society for Bioinformatics brings together people in Finland who
use or develop Bioconductor. **Everyone is welcome** — whether you have just
installed your first package or maintain several of them.

Come and meet the community at the [BioBeers](../events.qmd) and our other
events. We are also planning Bioconductor-related events, such as hackathons.

Would you like to help organise them? Join the organising committee by
contacting the society at
[fsfbioinf@gmail.com](mailto:fsfbioinf@gmail.com) or on
[Slack](https://bioinffi.slack.com/){target="_blank"}.

::::

:::::

## Who is who

Find Bioconductor people near you and get in touch. Click a pin or a name
to see who they are. The list shows the people in the visible part of the map.

Anyone in Finland who uses or develops Bioconductor tools is welcome on the
map. You do not need to be a member of the Finnish Society for Bioinformatics.
If you move abroad, you can stay on the map in your new location. Zoom out to
see the Finnish Bioconductor people around the world.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

source("../../R/render-bioc-map.R")

cat(render_bioc_map(
  "../../data/bioconductor_members.yaml",
  "../../data/country_outlines.geojson"
))
```

## Put yourself on the map

Add yourself to the map, update your details, or remove yourself by opening an
issue on GitHub. The request is checked automatically, and after a maintainer
approves it, the map is updated. Only your city is shown on the map, not your
exact location. All information you provide is public.

::: {.d-flex .flex-wrap .gap-2}

[Add me](https://github.com/Finnish-Society-for-Bioinformatics/website/issues/new?template=bioc-map-add.yml){.btn .btn-dark .rounded-pill target="_blank"}

[Update my details](https://github.com/Finnish-Society-for-Bioinformatics/website/issues/new?template=bioc-map-modify.yml){.btn .btn-outline-dark .rounded-pill target="_blank"}

[Remove me](https://github.com/Finnish-Society-for-Bioinformatics/website/issues/new?template=bioc-map-remove.yml){.btn .btn-outline-dark .rounded-pill target="_blank"}

:::

No GitHub account? Email us at
[fsfbioinf@gmail.com](mailto:fsfbioinf@gmail.com) and we will make the change
for you.
